gloss: to smooth down; to feel relieved

definitions.gloss: to smooth down; to stroke downward
definitions.explanation: To gently run one's hand down over something to smooth or calm it.
To feel a sense of relief (used in the expression {胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろす).

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}の{背中|せなか}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
{髪|かみ}を{優|やさ}しく{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I gently smoothed down the hair.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}の{頭|あたま}から{背中|せなか}にかけて{撫|な}で{下|お}ろしてやった。
examples.english: I stroked the dog from its head down to its back.

examples.japanese: {乱|みだ}れた{毛並|けな}みを{手|て}で{撫|な}で{下|お}ろして{整|ととの}えた。
examples.english: I smoothed down the ruffled fur with my hand to straighten it.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}ぐせのついた{髪|かみ}を{何度|なんど}も{撫|な}で{下|お}ろしたが、なかなか{直|なお}らなかった。
examples.english: I smoothed down my bed hair over and over, but it just wouldn't lie flat.

examples.japanese: {無事|ぶじ}だと{聞|き}いて{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that they were safe.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}して、やっと{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I finally felt relieved after passing the exam.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}が{成功|せいこう}したと{聞|き}いて{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that the surgery was successful.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}が{無事|ぶじ}に{着陸|ちゃくりく}して、{乗客|じょうきゃく}たちは{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: When the plane landed safely, the passengers all breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.japanese: {迷子|まいご}の{子供|こども}が{見|み}つかって、{親|おや}は{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: The lost child was found, and the parents were relieved.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE: {撫|な}でる (to stroke) + {下|お}ろす (to lower/bring down)

KEY EXPRESSION:
・{胸|むね}を{撫|な}で{下|お}ろす (to feel relieved, literally 'to stroke down one's chest')
  This is an idiomatic expression representing the physical gesture of relief.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes an object marked with を.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-す type)
・{撫|な}で{下|お}ろさない (negative)
・{撫|な}で{下|お}ろします (polite)
・{撫|な}で{下|お}ろして (te-form)
・{撫|な}で{下|お}ろした (past)
